messages:
marta: quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: hiring & org shifts  collecting the short Q&A here
leo: top-level: no company-wide hiring freeze. we are prioritizing hires for runtime, Dedicated capacity, and SRE. other reqs are under review.
anya: will people be moved between teams immediately or phased?
leo: phased. most reporting changes aim to take effect at the next pay period (two weeks). managers get an initial mapping CSV tomorrow.
marta: mobility window questions  when does it open and do I need manager sign-off to apply?
people-ops: mobility window opens Mon (7 working days). you can apply without formal sign-off but please give managers a heads-up; interviews get scheduling priority during the window.
anya: what about backfills if someone transfers out of a customer-facing role?
recruiting-bot: For critical customer-SLA roles file a "critical-backfill" note in #hq-hiring. target review: 72 hours.
leo: leveling/regrade: expedited calibrations for materially changed roles; standard cadence otherwise. file regrade requests with tag "reorg-impacted".
marta: will on-call or pager expectations change?
leo: no forced increase in rotations. we will rebalance rosters and provide temporary coverage if any team's pager load rises >20%.
people-ops: FAQ + manager checklist + templates will be posted in the all-hands folder by EOD. link will be shared here.
marta: thanks  i'll publish a short follow-up doc and tag owners for open items :thumbsup:
